Haryana Sees Administrative and Police Transfers Over Three Days

Over three consecutive days, Haryana has witnessed significant administrative and police reshuffling. On the third day, three Haryana Civil Services (HCS) officers were transferred. Previous days saw transfers of 20 police officers and HCS officials, along with several Sub-Inspectors (SI), Assistant Sub-Inspectors (ASI), and police personnel. Lists detailing these transfers and new postings have been released.
